DSimple Past · Complete with the Simple Past form. Use the verbs in brackets.

    Yesterday, Ece a short article about safe internet use. (read)

  2. 2

    Arda his old account password after the school lesson. (change)

  3. 3

    We our phones in our bags during the class trip. (keep)

  4. 4

    My sister a new offline hobby during the holiday. (try)

  5. 5

    Duru a helpful website with her study group. (share)

  6. 6

    The students a poster about mindful technology use. (make)

  7. 7

    Mert his screen time by an hour last weekend. (reduce)

  8. 8

    I a warning message on the school computer yesterday. (see)

  9. 9

    My cousins their grandparents after the morning lesson. (visit)

  10. 10

    Selin her favourite notebook to the workshop. (bring)

  11. 11

    We a reliable source before using the information. (check)

  12. 12

    Eren a polite comment about his friend’s drawing. (write)

  13. 13

    The children a model bridge for the science fair. (build)

  14. 14

    My father me a useful book about digital habits. (give)

  15. 15

    I about online privacy during the school presentation. (learn)
